notes.title: BubbleBeast Version 2.0!
notes.content:
[h2]Howdy Gamers![/h2]
Happy Friday! [b]Version 2.0[/b] of BubbleBeast DigiDungeon is officially live and at your fingertips! This is a small free update that fixes some bugs and adds some content!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] An endless mode, accessible after completing the main story! Pop until you drop, jam out to the tunes, and chase that high score!
[*] Full controller support! Now you can finally play BubbleBeast DigiDungeon with a [i]real[/i] joystick instead of just pretending!
[*] [REDACTED???]
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes and Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] The difficulty ranks for Level 4 and Level 5 have been adjusted. These are not applied retroactively, so you must complete the levels again for the new high scores to calculate.
[*] The "Big!" SFX has been given a slightly shorter attack.
[*] On mouse, the cursor's center is now aligned with the center of the playing field.
[*] Fixed a typo in the Pre-Level-5 Cutscene.
[*] Screenshake during the end-of-level bubble-clearing now has a maximum magnitude.
[*] You can now pause during the Results screen after each level.
[/list]
[h2]Soundtrack Release![/h2]
The official soundtrack to BubbleBeast DigiDungeon is now available on streaming platforms, as well as [b]on Steam as DLC[/b]! To celebrate, the DLC release of the OST will be [b]15% OFF until NEXT FRIDAY[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433370/

You can also catch it on YouTube, if you prefer!

[previewyoutube=Ksc3zKdR7ng;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Thank You For Your Support![/h2]
Please enjoy the update and the soundtrack! I talked about it during my last announcement, but the response to this silly lil game has been really overwhelming. Keep steppin' at your own pace! <3

- EchoLane

notes.title: More BubbleBeast Comes APRIL 25TH!
notes.content:
[h2]Official Soundtrack Release w/ BONUS TRACKS![/h2]
By pop-ular demand, the [b]official BubbleBeast DigiDungeon soundtrack[/b] will be releasing on [i]April 25th[/i] as a Steam DLC and on all major streaming services! Crave even [i]more[/i] music? The soundtrack release also comes with 3 NEVER-BEFORE-HEARD BONUS TRACKS- who could resist this popping power?

Wishlist the DLC and [url=https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/echolane/bubblebeast-digidungeon-original-game-soundtrack]presave the soundtrack on Spotify[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433370/BubbleBeast_DigiDungeon_Soundtrack/

[h2]Endless Mode is Coming![/h2]
Accompanying the soundtrack release, a free content update will also be releasing April 25th, bringing to BubbleBeast a frequently-requested [b]Endless Mode,[/b] along with some small tweaks and bugfixes.

[previewyoutube=OV8Pfqfpl0Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Thank You For Your Support! <3[/h2]
BubbleBeast DigiDungeon was developed part-time by a group of university students and recent graduates, and the positive reception to our silly little game has been overwhelming! For those of you who have played, and especially for those who have left reviews or comments saying that you enjoyed, thank you so much! Remember- KEEP STEPPIN' AT YOUR OWN PACE!

- EchoLane
